links.outcome: Baseline readability of head and neck cancer patient education materials versus recommended reading level
links.effect: Baseline mean FKGL of 10.1 and FRES of 51.5, exceeding national recommendations.
links.quote: Baseline readability was poor, with a mean FKGL of 10.1 and FRES of 51.5, exceeding national recommendations.

links.outcome: Readability of LLM-rewritten patient education materials after simplification prompt
links.effect: Gemini, Copilot, ChatGPT o3, DeepSeek significantly reduced FKGL; ChatGPT-4o minimal change; Claude increased difficulty. Gemini reached FKGL ≤7 in 81.8% of articles; Claude in none.
links.quote: Gemini, Copilot, ChatGPT o3, and DeepSeek significantly reduced FKGL compared to originals, while ChatGPT-4o showed minimal change and Claude increased difficulty.
